subject: BridgePoint co-sell demo: consolidating multi-region window and runbook
messages:
From: Jamie O'Neill <jamie@bridgepoint.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Marco Silva <marco@cloudwave.io>
Date: Tue, 7 Aug 2028 09:12:00 +0100
Subject: Re: BridgePoint co-sell demo: initial availability

Hi Rishi / Karthik —

Thanks for the quick sync last week. We locked an internal room for a March-style showcase and were hoping Redwood could lead the walkthrough for the inference runtime and fallbacks. High level ask: 45-minute technical demo + 15-minute Q&A, targeted for EMEA prospects (primarily Madrid/London/Frankfurt).

Constraints: CloudWave needs an ops window to rehearse (they're proposing 11:00–12:30 CET on 21 Aug), and our SI lead Anya is only available mornings (08:00–11:00 CET) that week. I included an agenda draft and the demo assets we promised.

Attachments: BridgePoint_MVP-Agenda.pdf

Would Redwood be comfortable with a staggered start (Redwood-led demo at 09:30 CET, followed by CloudWave run-of-show at 11:00 CET) or do you prefer a single consolidated block?

—Jamie
Principal Partnerships, BridgePoint AI
https://bridgepoint.ai
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Jamie O'Neill <jamie@bridgepoint.ai>, Marco Silva <marco@cloudwave.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Aug 2028 13:04:00 +0100
Subject: Re: BridgePoint co-sell demo: initial availability

Thanks Jamie — I reviewed the agenda. We can run the core demo and keep the first 10 minutes focused on deployment/topology and the final 10 minutes on fallbacks and cost knobs. Two asks from our side:

- Can CloudWave commit an ops rehearsal on 20 Aug 11:00–11:45 CET (30 min dry-run + buffer)?
- Can BridgePoint add the prospect list so we can tune examples (embeddings + reranking) to vertical-specific prompts?

If the SI lead (Anya) is only mornings, the consolidated single block on 21 Aug 09:30–11:00 CET works for us, but we need CloudWave to shift their 11:00 rehearsal earlier or accept that their run-of-show will begin after our demo.

I'll tentatively block 21 Aug 09:00–11:30 CET on our calendar and circulate a consolidated runbook if we land on the single-block approach.

Rishi
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Marco Silva <marco@cloudwave.io>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Jamie O'Neill <jamie@bridgepoint.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Aug 2028 08:17:00 +0100
Subject: Re: BridgePoint co-sell demo: initial availability

On Wed, 7 Aug 2028, Rishi Malhotra wrote:
> If the SI lead (Anya) is only mornings, the consolidated single block on 21 Aug 09:30–11:00 CET works for us...

We can slide our rehearsal to 20 Aug 09:30–10:15 CET instead of 11:00 — that clears the 11:00 slot. We need 30–45 mins for the CloudWave preflight to validate region failover and routing policies.

One catch: our ops engineer on the 20th has a conflicting customer emergency until 08:45 CET. If Redwood can start the preflight at 09:30 sharp (no buffer), we should still be fine.

Marco Silva
Partner Solutions, CloudWave
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Jamie O'Neill <jamie@bridgepoint.ai>, Marco Silva <marco@cloudwave.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Anya Petrov <anya@systemsinc.ai>
Date: Thu, 9 Aug 2028 16:09:00 +0100
Subject: Re: BridgePoint co-sell demo: consolidated runbook + calendar confirmation

Great — thanks for the flexibility, Marco. Final plan below: please confirm by EOD Friday so I can publish the runbook and the calendar invite.

Planned schedule (CEST):
- 20 Aug 09:30–10:15 — CloudWave ops rehearsal (CloudWave team only) — meeting link: https://meet.redwood.com/rehearsal-bp-20aug
- 21 Aug 09:30–10:15 — Redwood-led demo (technical walkthrough + live inference) — 45 minutes including 10 min Q&A
- 21 Aug 10:15–11:00 — BridgePoint customer Q&A + SI deep-dive (Anya lead)

Runbook highlights (will post full doc to shared Drive):
- Point people: Rishi (Redwood demo lead), Marco (CloudWave ops), Anya (SI deep-dive)
- Fallbacks: Redwood will auto-fail to quantized variant if GPU pool constrained — will call this out during the demo
- Artifacts: Redwood will upload the demo package (redwood-demo-package.zip) and BridgePoint will upload the prospect matrix to the shared Drive link above

Open items:
- Jamie: prospect list + any redlines to the agenda (I marked a couple of placeholder prompts in the agenda)
- Marco: confirm ops engineer can join 20 Aug 09:30 sharp
- Anya: confirm 21 Aug 09:30 start works for SI deep-dive timing

If we get confirmations, I'll send a final calendar invite with the consolidated calendar blocks and the Drive link.

Thanks all — looking forward to it.

Rishi Malhotra
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1-415-555-0123
